The toolset I have access to in this session (`mobile-mcp`) is UI-automation only — tap/swipe/screenshot/list-elements, plus app install/launch and crash report retrieval. - Access to a shell/adb tool to run `adb logcat` if the app logs it, or `adb shell` with a debugger (e.g., attaching JDWP)
- Read access to the app's source/decompiled code to see the `applyDiscount()` formula
- A debug build that surfaces the value in the UI
